effective_contract_rule: all base-contract requirements remain exact except the named change_scope objects, which are replaced by this closed successor

exact_private_tuple.utf8_bytes: runtime-computed positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden
exact_private_tuple.source_count: producer-attested positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden

private_canonicalization.rule: runtime alone canonicalizes an admitted public v2 object into the existing byte-identical private v1 tuple; public and private schema identifiers are independent
private_canonicalization.schema_stability: private v1 remains valid only because its exact tuple bytes and semantics are unchanged

public_fresh_hint_v2.fresh_only: optional by absence on fresh composer/edit sends; no-composer, programmatic, non-fresh, resume, and active-stream interject paths omit
public_fresh_hint_v2.prefix_utf16_code_units: positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden; equals renderer composer.templateLength
public_fresh_hint_v2.producer_rule: prefix_utf16_code_units=composer.templateLength and source_count=composer.commands.length at the sole fresh request writer; generic and active fresh provider-run ingresses converge
public_fresh_hint_v2.privacy: no composer object, rawText, raw prefix/content, command/name/toolkit/id/path/URL/digest/hash, arbitrary label, contribution array, utf8_bytes claim, or extra key
public_fresh_hint_v2.source_count: positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden; renderer-attested expanded-invocation count; runtime validates structure/range only and never claims independent command provenance
public_fresh_hint_v2.v1_input: unsupported at the v2 boundary; reject for composition only with fresh_hint_invalid; never heuristically upgrade or dual-parse

runtime_admission.authoritative_input: expanded fresh message plus public v2 prefix_utf16_code_units/source_count
runtime_admission.boundary_rule: interpret prefix_utf16_code_units as JavaScript UTF-16 code units; require 0 < boundary <= authoritative message UTF-16 length; reject a boundary between a valid high/low surrogate pair
runtime_admission.failure: any schema/key/type/range/boundary/surrogate/scalar violation is fresh_hint_invalid; no private mint/persist; ordinary V4/chat/provider/tools/interactions/base RunBundle continues
runtime_admission.scalar_rule: selected prefix must be a valid Unicode scalar sequence; any unpaired high or low surrogate in the prefix is invalid and is never replacement-encoded
runtime_admission.utf8_rule: slice the authoritative message at the validated UTF-16 boundary, then independently compute strict UTF-8 byte length; no renderer utf8_bytes value is accepted
